title: CEPO: A General Framework for Improving Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.34722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) require both effective coordination and specialized task execution. Existing prompt optimization approaches typically couple these functions within agent-specific prompts. We introduce Coordinator-Executor Prompt Optimization (CEPO), a general framework for improving prompt optimization in MAS. CEPO separates system-level coordination from agent-level execution through a shared coordinator prompt and agent-specific executor prompts, and guides their updates according to their respective roles. This structure allows shared coordination rules to be refined consistently across agents while keeping execution instructions separately adjustable. CEPO provides the prompt structure and optimization guidance, while existing prompt optimizers perform the underlying search. translated_title: CEPO：一种改进多智能体系统提示优化的通用框架
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统（MAS）既需要有效的协调，也需要专门化的任务执行。现有的提示优化方法通常将这些功能耦合在特定于智能体的提示中。我们提出了协调器-执行器提示优化（CEPO），这是一个用于改进多智能体系统提示优化的通用框架。CEPO通过共享的协调器提示和各智能体专属的执行器提示，将系统级协调与智能体级执行分离，并根据各自的角色指导其更新。这种结构使得共享的协调规则能够在各智能体之间得到一致的优化，同时保持执行指令可以单独调整。CEPO提供提示结构和优化指导，而底层搜索则由现有的提示优化器完成。跨越四个领域的11个基准测试的大量实验表明，将CEPO应用于四个现有的提示优化器均能持续提升性能。
tldr: CEPO提出了一种通用框架，通过将系统级协调与智能体级执行分离为独立的提示并进行针对性优化，显著提升了多智能体系统中现有提示优化器的性能。
en_tdlr: CEPO is a general framework that improves prompt optimization in multi-agent systems by separating system-level coordination from agent-level execution into distinct prompts, consistently enhancing the performance of existing prompt optimizers across 11 benchmarks.
